note: Single source for the results table, the open items and the closed list of studies/2026-11-16-scutoid-interactions. Write-up only: every number is copied from the source study named in its row; nothing was recomputed. Verdict words: ESTABLISHED, CONSISTENT, NOT CONFIRMED, NOT A TEST, PARKED (each the source study's own verdict mapped without upgrade; the source wording is kept in 'own').

rows.data: 120-cell, truncated 120-cell, bitruncated 600-cell swept as tiling sequences; two generic directions
rows.observed: births / swaps / deaths 116 / 366 / 116; 716 / 966 / 716; 716 / 2166 / 716, exact; truncated 600-cell: no pure swap
rows.expected: h1 / h2 / h3 of #104 Theorems 1 and 2 (same numbers)
rows.own: logger built and validated; all predictions held

rows.system: Null model: moving Poisson-Voronoi seeds, linear motion
rows.data: 2D and 3D periodic Voronoi, simulated and integrated
rows.observed: 2D: 3.04 +- 0.005 T1 per cell per spacing (finest step); 3D: 15.53 +- 0.07 contact changes per cell per spacing; swaps per birth in a swept 3D Poisson-Voronoi 4.7669 +- 0.0006
rows.own: SETTLED; two methods agree (simulation converges from below, 0.7% and 0.5% short at the finest step)

rows.data: N = 512 cells, three generic motions, two time steps
rows.observed: 30,758 contact changes, 0 simultaneous at a 1e-9 time floor, 0 clumps; lattice control caught (10 simultaneous)
rows.expected: one contact at a time (#104 Theorem 1' read for moving 3D tilings)
rows.own: a computation, not a proof: checks the generic statement on these motions

rows.system: 2D dry froth in its scaling state (Potts model)
rows.data: 2048^2 torus, seed 2, 3624 to 903 bubbles, window passing the scaling test fixed in advance
rows.observed: 0.48 +- 0.02 macroscopic T1 per T2 at rc = 1 pixel, step-independent within 4%; 0.64 / 0.32 at rc = 0.5 / 2
rows.own: agrees at the natural choice rc = 1 pixel; the claim of rc-independence FAILS on the lattice; stationary mu2 1.90 against 1.24

rows.data: 6 runs, 3 seeds, 1001 to 2500 vanishings per window
rows.observed: 1.22 to 1.27 swaps per vanished grain; macroscopic 0.06 to 0.14
rows.expected: about 1.34 (Sprague et al. 2009, unverified) and 3/2 with side-shedding; macroscopic 0.53
rows.own: macroscopic count does NOT agree with 0.53; control partly failed (von Neumann slope 0.76, mu2 1.9 to 2.0 against 1.620)

rows.observed: mean faces 13.65 to 13.85; survivors' net contact change per vanished grain e.g. -1.49, -1.66, -2.18
rows.own: control passes; the identity holds in the steady windows

rows.system: Earth: plate reconstructions, 230 Ma to now
rows.data: Müller 2016, Müller 2019 (three readings), Matthews 2016, Merdith 2021; independent history Scotese & Wright 2018
rows.observed: persistent swaps 23 to 35 (10 to 15 per 100 Myr), step-independent at 1 to 5 Myr; per plate per 100 Myr 0.44 to 0.58 (Müller family) against 0.07 (Scotese & Wright)
rows.expected: no null rate; test: agreement across independent histories, clustering at reorganisations
rows.own: agreement does NOT carry over to an independent history; no clustering beyond chance (p 0.12 to 0.28); counts describe the models, not the Earth

rows.data: Bifrost runs en024048_hion and qs024048_by3363, 13 settings, steps 10 to 80 s
rows.observed: 0.07 to 0.15 persistent swaps per cell per minute at 10 s; 0.6 to 1.3 per cell lifetime; 0.8 to 1.9 per persistent split (spread over settings); corrected by the control's detection fraction and fitted to step 0: 0.08 to 0.16 (median 0.13) at P = 60 s, +-9 to 15% per setting plus about 15% calibration, but the corrected rate still halves from step 0 to 80 s and moves by up to 30% with P
rows.expected: no null rate (births at junctions almost absent, so swaps per birth is undefined)
rows.own: NOT CONFIRMED: corrected rate still step-dependent and P-dependent; the step-0 value is an extrapolation, not a stable rate; order of magnitude stable

rows.observed: 0.03 to 0.15 persistent swaps per cell-hour; within about 30% over 2.5 to 10 min steps, threefold over settings
rows.own: FEASIBLE; rates NOT yet stable; no rate goes into the comparison table

rows.observed: 0 to 33 usable cells; no event time series for polygons
rows.own: NOT feasible from the geostationary images; no usable time series

rows.data: pmwd, 256^3 particles in 256 Mpc/h, watershed basins R = 3 to 6 Mpc/h, two seeds, down to Delta a = 1/512
rows.observed: share of contact changes that come alone 0.60 at the finest spacing (about 0.65 to 0.7 extrapolated); about 25 contact changes per merged basin (23 to 27)
rows.expected: all single (Theorem 1') for generic tilings; voxel tilings are not generic
rows.own: cannot test Theorem 1' in its exact form; residual clumping DECIDED to be the discreteness of the units (falls with finer voxels and tracers), zero in the continuum an extrapolation

rows.system: Interstellar bubbles (toy, rung 5 of the foam ladder)
rows.data: 2D toy slice; public ISM data single-epoch or about 10 Myr apart
rows.observed: Euler fails in 223 of 240 frames; swaps 0.01 per vanished cell (flicker)
rows.own: toy rule FAILS as a tiling; real data give no usable time series

rows.data: perfect hexagonal mosaic; four open micro-CT mosaics (ODA-3D)
rows.observed: one edge family flips when anisotropy A reaches sqrt 3 across the rows (1024 of 3039 edges at A = 1.74, none at 1.72), never along rows; real mosaics: swaps start well below sqrt 3 (0.2% for A < 1.2 to 33% at 2.5 to 3)
rows.expected: prediction stated before data (commit 2bf1098a): swaps in oval eyes, about none in near-spherical ones
rows.own: law proved for the perfect mosaic and calibrated on four real mosaics; no scutoid observed

rows.system: Compound eyes: depth traces (butterfly gw05, gw16)
rows.data: Paukner et al. 2024 X-ray volumes, 0.6 um voxels
rows.observed: gw05 cone layer 10 of about 1330 pairs change against 4.2 +- 2.1; gw16 retina 799 of 4786 against null 809 +- 34; 0 of 1505 flagged changes a true exchange
rows.expected: about 1% scattered changes for these nearly evenly curved eyes, below the method's resolution
rows.own: NOT A TEST OF THE PREDICTION (relabelled 16 Nov with DICTO); kept as method development

rows.data: cyclone centres PJ4 to PJ30 (Mura et al. 2021 via Gavriel & Kaspi 2022)
rows.observed: 0 swaps: cyclic order 1-2-3-4-5 in all 19 of 22 epochs where all five were seen; one sixth cyclone formed in Sep 2019 and was gone by Feb 2020 (an insertion, not a 2-2 move)
rows.expected: no rate possible (6 cells, one event in 9 years)
rows.own: event catalogue, never a rate; scope SETTLED

rows.data: hole columns between lens surfaces of 0 to 10 D base curve
rows.observed: uneven stretch at most 1.15 : 1; 0 swaps for regular layouts; 1 to 4 in about 175 edges for spiral and random holes
rows.expected: sqrt 3 = 1.73 : 1 needed before a hexagonal lattice swaps
rows.own: one negative: no scutoids in spectacle lenses (computed, 7 controls passed)

rows.observed: swaps not observable in one section; file starts plus ends 0.021 per file per cell (manual outlines)
rows.own: PARKED (DICTO 16 Nov: 'forget the yew sample unless available online')

open.item: Compound eye with strongly uneven curvature
open.why: the one direct test of a scutoid prediction in living tissue; the prediction is stated and timestamped, the law proved
open.next: find an open volume of an unevenly curved eye with a published cell segmentation (acute-zone or flattened eyes: dragonflies, robber flies, mantises, mantis shrimp; the 29-ommatidium oval wasp eye of Makarova et al. 2025 as the small first case), then trace with the gw16 pipeline and the contact-length restriction

open.item: Serial-section test of swaps per birth = <F>/2 - 3 in a real 3D grain map
open.why: an exact law of the #104 kind, tested on real data with no time series and no tracking error: 3.883 predicted for steady grain growth against 4.768 for Poisson-Voronoi
open.next: fetch one public 3D EBSD or DCT grain volume, sweep it by planes with the shared logger, compare swaps per birth with <F>/2 - 3 of the same volume

open.item: Sun: a swap rate stable under the time step
open.why: the only natural 2D tiling with thousands of swaps; the step-0 fit with the moving-Voronoi detection fraction (16 Nov) still leaves the rate halving from step 0 to 80 s and moving with P, and shuffled frames give as many swap patterns as real ones at 10 s
open.next: calibrate with a control that has splits and merges (the scaling-state froth drawn as images, with its exact T1 list) and count a swap only when all four cells are matched by overlap above a fixed share, a rule unrelated frames must fail; then refit to step 0

open.item: Froth benchmark on a vertex model with a fixed microscopic rc
open.why: fixes whether the macroscopic count (Rutenberg-McCurdy rule) is rc-free, the rule every stream would quote
open.next: a vertex-model froth with a fixed T1 length, count rule RM at rc and 2rc in the scaling state, against 0.53 +- 0.05

open.item: Earth: per-plate rates with a resolution control
open.why: decides whether the Müller-family swap count is plate resolution or a rate shared with an independent history
open.next: merge the family's microplates to Scotese-size plates and recount persistent swaps per plate per 100 Myr
